text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mayano Top Gun doesn't show up for training, so I head out to look for her, when…

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: You seem pretty frazzled. Looking for something?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oh! Lemme guess… You're looking for me, aren'tcha?! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I know! Why don't you join us for hide-and-seek. We're in the middle of a game right now. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Huh? Of course I'm okay… Oh, wait.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Training, right? Did you get worried when I didn't show?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry! That face—I didn't mean to make you so upset!
choice_data_list: Just be more careful next time.
Just be more careful next time.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yeah… I'll try my best not to worry you! I don't want you looking like that ever again!
